manual_merge_requirements: exact pull-request head passes the aggregate required check
proof digest equality passes across configured CPU backends
affected proof and formal sessions are rebuilt
a human reviews and manually merges the update

routine-cargo.reason: Cargo version-update pull requests are paused while the root and spikes lockfiles stay byte-frozen to the v1.0 proof identity; they resume in the next identity cycle behind the aggregate required check enforced by the default-branch ruleset.

routine-actions.reason: Merges pass through a pull request and the aggregate required check enforced by the default-branch ruleset, followed by release-manifest regeneration.

claim_boundary: Grouping controls merge authority; it never suppresses advisories, alerts, or security updates. Cargo version-update pull requests are paused only because the frozen v1.0 lockfiles cannot merge them; the pause ends with the next identity cycle.
